title: Deccy node
description: Base structure of a single node in the deccy graph. One node maps to one jj change (mmsmukkk); the node's id is the change id and lives in the filename (nodes/<id>.json), not in the document. Nodes are of two kinds (zkvxornu) and declare their outgoing edges: depends_on lists the nodes this node depends on (its prerequisites) and evaluates lists the nodes this node evaluates (mkyoyqvt).

kind.description: The node's type. Decisions cover constraints, design choices and implementations; evaluations cover review criteria, tests and other quality checks (zkvxornu).

depends_on.description: Ids of the nodes this node depends on. Decisions always carry depends_on edges; evaluations may additionally carry depends_on (lnqowznu); targets may be decisions or evaluations. Each entry is a jj change id matching a sibling file in nodes/.

evaluates.description: Ids of the nodes this node evaluates. Only an evaluation may carry evaluates edges (lnqowznu); targets may be decisions or evaluations. Each entry is a jj change id matching a sibling file in nodes/.

content.description: The node's content. Kept open so new content types can be added without a schema change; only type, ref and rationale are required. When ref is "inline" the content is embedded in the content field; otherwise ref is a repo-relative path to the content.

ref.description: "inline" when the content is embedded in the content field, otherwise a non-empty list of repo-relative paths to the content.

content.description: Inline content, present only when ref is "inline".
